main_text.head: AMPLISSIMIS, NOBILISSIMIS, CLARISSIMIS, ET SPECTATISSIMIS DD. CONSVLIBVS, SENATVI, POPVLOQ. TIGVRINO, HELVETIORVM PRIMARIO, ET S.Rom.Imperii Libero:
Prapofito & Canonicis Collegiata Ecclefia Tigurina, caterifque Ecclefiarum Doctoribus.
DOMINIS ET AMICIS SVIS S. D.

p.i: VAS vobis offero Antiquitates, Viri Opt. Max. fi Auctor, vt multos annos parturiuit, progignere tandem Diis Nixiis & Egeriâ opitulante potuiffet, omnes fibi aternùm obligaffet, qui optimarum artium & pietatis in studio versantur. Ita enim ab illo sunt collecta & scripta, vt si recte oculis vtor, nihil viderim ex vlla atate hoc in genere doctius, nihil penficulatius. Quare non modo praftantis cuiufdam industria parta illi laus est & erit, dum hac mundi machina, sed etiam fingularis ingenij & doctrina. Quas animi eius dotes cum iam pridem olim multis e scriptis ab eo in lucem emissis cognouistis, tum in hoc eruditissimo scripto, & ad intelligendum illustrandumá Francia & Alamannia noftra antiquitates accommodatissimo, vehementer scio mecum admirabimini. Quod quamuis necdum formauerit vrsinum in modum lambendo; tamē vsque ab vnguiculo ad capillum summum (vt cum Plauto loquar) est feftiuissimum. Nõ dubito quidem fore plerosque, qui nec recte sibi

page.notes: The initial "O" is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "VAS" with the initial included in the text; the initial letter itself is an ornamental woodcut and is not reproduced. Some lines of the title block are set in mixed roman, italic and small capitals; the abbreviation "Rom." and the dash in "Collegiata" are as printed. Marginal characters at the right edge are show-through or damage and are not transcribed. Doubtful: "Diis Nixiis" and "ftiuiffimum" as printed; the word "fefti-uissimum" reads "feftiuissimum" in the scan.
